transcript.text: Thank you, Marisol. I'll walk you through what I experienced. In the first meeting, I was about five minutes into presenting my design proposal when Kai cut in to question my methodology. Before I could respond, he redirected the discussion to an alternative approach he preferred, and my proposal was never returned to. In the second meeting, I had prepared a detailed walkthrough of user flow options, and again Kai interrupted mid-presentation to shift focus to his own suggestions. The group ended up discussing his ideas for the remainder of the session. In the third meeting, I was presenting revised wireframes based on prior feedback. Kai interjected to critique the revisions and steered the conversation toward a different priority area. In all three cases, I was not given the opportunity to finish my presentation or have the group properly review my proposals. The pattern I experienced was that each time I was in a presenting role, Kai would interrupt and redirect, effectively excluding my work from receiving fair consideration by the group.
